pull_requests.body:
## Existing SWT-owned geometry, not another framework

This continuation targets only `ViewportScrollBarGeometry` in the existing common widget implementation. No runtime dependency, new widget/viewport framework, storage owner or JNI ABI is added. M3JDK21 remains the integrated SDK product; Synexia owns build-time recipe convergence.

**Initial proof commit `30814fe4c1662bdc699b8f0ec25681c6945701a3` does NOT modify production Java.** It publishes the exact canonical recipe proof first. Production receiving must be a separate one-file commit only after actual SDK generation and generated-source tests execute successfully. The final CI receiver comparison deliberately refuses until that is done.

### Reproduced defects
Exact original SWT head `839ce8a904cfe399912caea7f58bd59713a8fbbb`; target blob `1fd72c44bf9dcd5c2beca6ce95388640f48e0f67`.

1. `thumbLength(100,8,0,Integer.MAX_VALUE,Integer.MAX_VALUE-1)` returns **8**, not the independent rational result **100**. Page+1 and range+1 overflow before division.
2. `hit(0,16,Integer.MAX_VALUE,8,0,100,10,0)` returns **NONE**, not **ARROW_DECREASE**, because `2*arrow+track` wraps.
3. Thumb position and drag-selection mapping inherit the first error through their length dependency.

### Implementation candidate
Widen page/range additions and hit endpoint expressions BEFORE evaluating them. Preserve the original int mulDiv method and signed rounding/zero-denominator behavior via a private bounded-long overload. Keep the existing thumbStart/selectionAt algorithms, clamping, no-thumb and non-scrollable sentinel. No allocation, runtime BigInteger, floating point, new native symbol or public/package ABI change.

The numeric domain is valid nonnegative int scrollbar state, valid bounded selection, nonnegative track/arrow and positive minimum thumb. Full numeric support is not a claim that native windows can have arbitrary extreme pixel dimensions.

### Canonical recipe and source custody
[Synexia #12544](https://github.com/hsoliwal/com.synexia/pull/12544) at `9372a2d57f1a05394172a7bd85dda3f0d6d83983`, named recipe `com.synexia.swt.ScrollbarFullRange20261020`.

Existing engine `M3HashPinnedJavaSnapshotRecipe` blob `135a28d0cec9ea988607cdef6caa1f0fe5115d75`, scope owner `9174dd681f0d75b5086fc19904a71524a03972dc`, enum `274360816db1e44a2f1796a3bc5cdeff6b0ce6db`. Target-side copies are byte-identical build-time proof/custody, not a competing recipe authority. Existing Apache-2.0 OR EPL-2.0 target header remains unchanged. Canonical catalogue evaluates incumbent rational scaling, interval bounds, rejected floating point/new JNI, and licensed/reference-only donors.

Seven authored JUnit/OpenRewrite tests cover exact generation, fixed point, missing/duplicate/drift/semantic-change refusal and code-looking decoys under input permutations. Generated-source verification requires actual `Result.getAfter()` output and will not substitute the resource template.

### Tests actually completed locally
Debian OpenJDK21.0.12.1/Linux x86_64, strict `--release 21 -proc:none -Xlint:all -Werror`:
- Original and candidate: **5,723,783 assertions per tiered run** against an independent BigInteger oracle.
- Candidate: zero discrepancies; separate full C1 candidate run also passed.
- Original: zero ordinary-range discrepancies, with extreme-boundary length/start/selection/hit counterexamples retained.
- Package/public descriptors identical; four compiled negative controls rejected by the unchanged oracle.
- Expected-value oracle digest identifies the corpus, not baseline/candidate output equivalence.

No local Maven/SDK execution is claimed. The exact-head Linux/Windows/macOS jobs execute it, but are Java arithmetic qualification, **not native SWT display tests**.

### HOLD and scope
Keep draft. Native Win32 extreme pixels/real input, GTK/Cocoa geometry, DPI, accessibility/events/resource lifetimes, SWT/Tycho and full M3JDK21 receiving/performance gates remain unexecuted. Historical Win32 samples stop at maximum 100000 and 100% DPI; old samples are preserved, not relabeled fresh evidence. No unrelated M3File/M3AST migration is included. Bounded deduplication found attribution checkpoint #207; row-window #229 and GTK disposal work are distinct. Full history audit and all-widget support are not claimed.

No merge, force-push, rebase or release-contract promotion.

## Additive production receiver for hash-pinned PR #236

This stacks on proof-only [#236](https://github.com/hsoliwal/eclipse.platform.swt/pull/236) without modifying its branch. It changes exactly one production Java source (`ViewportScrollBarGeometry.java`) using the **unchanged byte-exact canonical generated receiver** from Synexia recipe [#12544](https://github.com/hsoliwal/com.synexia/pull/12544), and adds one local Java21 proof receipt.

The original `master` and proof branch source blob was `1fd72c44bf9dcd5c2beca6ce95388640f48e0f67`. The received source blob equals the canonical generator output `7370ac91ca85784b7b72efabef4129ffbfd3cea3`, SHA-256 `df4f8498b1f633f2ffeae310f761ecaa0ea686e392557b8cfe2c684864a7f9b4`; no second geometry class, API change, JNI symbol or runtime dependency is introduced.

### Executed exact-byte verification

`javac --release 21 -encoding UTF-8 -Xlint:all -Werror` compiled the exact candidate and exact proof files (verified Git blob IDs), followed by `ScrollbarFullRangeProof strict`:

```text
GEOMETRY_PASS checks=5723783 ordinaryFailures=0 oracleDigest=27d10dbfbd5f515a
mulDiv mismatches=0
hasThumb mismatches=0
thumbLength mismatches=0
thumbStart mismatches=0
selectionAt mismatches=0

```

The source-receiving commit is `8e5eb98cb71b2751a6690d34aece98973e246f9c`; `RECEIVER_LOCAL_JAVA21_PROOF.md` records source and test lineage.

### Required before merging to protected master

The canonical Maven/OpenRewrite SDK and fixed-point recipe replay have **not** run in this session (Maven unavailable). The existing receiver workflow must verify generation equality and actual SDK JUnit on this exact head. SWT/Tycho, native Win32/GTK/Cocoa, DPI, accessibility and disposal remain pending, as do M3JDK21 JDK/JNI/HotSpot gates. Keep this PR draft until that evidence is available.

No force-push, rebase, squash or destructive conflict choice; historical proof and baseline remain reachable.

pull_requests.head: 9372a2d57f1a05394172a7bd85dda3f0d6d83983
pull_requests.body:
## One original SWT owner; canonical recipe first

Substantiated continuation of the October 20 scrollbar audit. Reuses **existing `M3HashPinnedJavaSnapshotRecipe`** at current canonical engine blob `135a28d0cec9ea988607cdef6caa1f0fe5115d75`, not another rewrite/runtime framework. Product target is SWT's existing `ViewportScrollBarGeometry`; M3JDK21 remains the integrated SDK product and no M3File/M3AST migration is needed for this arithmetic defect.

### Defects reproduced on exact current source
SWT master `839ce8a904cfe399912caea7f58bd59713a8fbbb`, file `bundles/org.eclipse.swt/Eclipse SWT/common/org/eclipse/swt/widgets/ViewportScrollBarGeometry.java`, original blob `1fd72c44bf9dcd5c2beca6ce95388640f48e0f67`.

- `thumbLength(100,8,0,Integer.MAX_VALUE,Integer.MAX_VALUE-1)` returns **8**, independently specified rational result **100**. Both page+1 and range+1 must widen before arithmetic.
- `hit(0,16,Integer.MAX_VALUE,8,0,100,10,0)` returns **NONE** because the outer endpoint overflows; expected **ARROW_DECREASE**.
- Thumb placement and drag selection inherit the first error through thumb length.

### Candidate
Preserve the package-level int mulDiv signature and exact legacy int behavior (including zero denominator), factor its rounding atom through a private bounded-long overload, and widen page/range and hit endpoint expressions. No allocation, runtime BigInteger, floating point, new storage, new native symbol, callback, widget framework or public ABI. Target dual license Apache-2.0 OR EPL-2.0 is unchanged; recipe/test expression is first-party Apache-2.0.

### Actual local fixture evidence
Strict Java21 `--release 21 -proc:none -Xlint:all -Werror` on Debian OpenJDK21.0.12.1/Linux x86_64. **5,723,783 assertions per version** against an independent BigInteger oracle. Candidate: zero mismatches. Original: zero ordinary-range mismatches; 1,156 length, 571 start, 1,771 selection and 1,124,782 hit discrepancies across adversarial boundary/extreme configurations. These counts overlap and are not unique native GUI bugs. Existing mulDiv/hasThumb agree with their oracles.

### Required next gate
Seven authored real SDK tests cover exact generation, fixed point, drift/missing/duplicate/semantic-change refusal and code-looking decoys under input permutations. They must actually run. The verifier consumes **only `Result.getAfter()` bytes** emitted by the SDK; it cannot substitute the candidate template. No production SWT source is changed in this commit. Local Maven/dependency retrieval was unavailable; this exact-head workflow is the executable generation lane, not a preclaimed pass.

### Scope and HOLD
The numeric domain is explicitly documented: valid nonnegative int scrollbar state, valid bounded selection, nonnegative track/arrow and positive minimum thumb. This does not claim a native window of any extreme size is supported. Prior SWT #229 row-window fix and disposal PRs are distinct; exact geometry PR search found only attribution checkpoint #207. Search/history coverage is bounded, not complete.

Native Win32 extreme-range pixels/real drag, GTK/Cocoa, DPI, accessibility/events/lifetimes, SWT/Tycho and full M3JDK21 compatibility remain NOT_RUN. Existing Win32 historical samples covered maximum <=100000 at 100% DPI. Keep draft; do not auto-merge, rebase, force-push, weaken native gates or upgrade release claims.
